<description>

| Binary | master (MB) | PR (MB) |

| bitcoin-cli | 8.20 | 7.72 |
| bitcoin-qt | 43.87 | 43.87 |
| bitcoin-tx | 4.93 | 4.45 |
| bitcoin-util | 4.52 | 4.04 |
| bitcoin-wallet | 9.26 | 8.77 |
| bitcoind | 17.75 | 17.27 |

See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html:

</description>

diff --git a/contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm b/contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm
index e18cbdf808..d0e5478958 100644
--- a/contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm
+++ b/contrib/guix/manifest_gui.scm
@@ -50,7 +50,9 @@
           ((string-contains target "-linux-")

                  gawk
-                 (make-bitcoin-cross-toolchain target) ;; glibc 2.31 based
+                 (make-bitcoin-cross-toolchain target ;; glibc 2.31 based

                  pkg-config))
           ((string-contains target "darwin")

diff --git a/depends/packages/boost.mk b/depends/packages/boost.mk
index 902c018ff1..2ee7aae4b5 100644
--- a/depends/packages/boost.mk
+++ b/depends/packages/boost.mk
@@ -4,6 +4,11 @@ $(package)_download_path = https://github.com/boostorg/boost/releases/download/b
 $(package)_file_name = boost-$($(package)_version)-cmake.tar.gz
 $(package)_sha256_hash = f51707c27359a0df0cac1beada86de31bb5eed5e8285592dadec384df99c2984
 $(package)_build_subdir = build
+$(package)_patches += drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
+
+define $(package)_preprocess_cmds
+  patch -p1 < $($(package)_patch_dir)/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
+endef
 
 define $(package)_set_vars
   $(package)_config_opts = -DBOOST_INCLUDE_LIBRARIES="multi_index;test"
diff --git a/contrib/guix/guix-build b/contrib/guix/guix-build
index d49f3c637d..45da4470b3 100755
--- a/contrib/guix/guix-build
+++ b/contrib/guix/guix-build
@@ -324,12 +324,13 @@ for host in $HOSTS; do
         # for the particular $HOST we're building for
         export HOST="$host"
 
-        # Make local modules available
+        # Make local modules available. These are passed to `guix shell` via
+        # --load-path, rather than exported via GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH, so they are
+        # only seen by the pinned Guix.
         package_path="${VERSION_BASE}/guix-package-path"
         mkdir -p "$package_path"
         ln -sfn "${PWD}/contrib/guix/toolchains.scm" "${package_path}/toolchains.scm"
         ln -sfn "${PWD}/contrib/guix/patches" "${package_path}/patches"
-        export GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH="$package_path"
 
 cat << EOF
 INFO: Building ${VERSION:?not set} for platform triple ${HOST:?not set}:
@@ -398,6 +399,11 @@ EOF
         #     make the downloaded depends sources available to it. The sources
         #     should have been downloaded prior to this invocation.
         #
+        #   --load-path="$package_path"
+        #
+        #                     make our local modules (contrib/guix/toolchains.scm)
+        #                     available to the manifests
+        #
         #   --keep-failed     keep build tree of failed builds
         #
         #     When builds of the Guix environment itself (not Bitcoin Core)
@@ -429,6 +435,7 @@ EOF
             ${SOURCES_PATH:+--share="$SOURCES_PATH"}
             ${BASE_CACHE:+--share="$BASE_CACHE"}
             ${SDK_PATH:+--share="$SDK_PATH"}
+            --load-path="$package_path"
             --cores="$JOBS"
             --keep-failed
             --fallback
diff --git a/contrib/guix/toolchains.scm b/contrib/guix/toolchains.scm
index 44fd01e1c8..429e860d18 100644
--- a/contrib/guix/toolchains.scm
+++ b/contrib/guix/toolchains.scm
@@ -200,11 +200,12 @@ chain for " target " development."))
                   "--disable-gcov"
                   "--disable-libgomp"
                   "--disable-libsanitizer"
+                  "--disable-libstdcxx-filesystem-ts"
                   "--disable-lto"
                   "--disable-nls"
                   #$building-on)))))))
 
-(define linux-base-gcc
+(define* (make-linux-base-gcc #:key (wchar_t? #t))
   (package
     (inherit base-gcc)
     (arguments
@@ -223,9 +224,13 @@ chain for " target " development."))
                   "--disable-libgomp"
                   "--disable-libquadmath"
                   "--disable-libsanitizer"
+                  "--disable-libstdcxx-filesystem-ts"
                   "--disable-lto"
                   "--disable-nls"
                   "--disable-tm-clone-registry"
+                  #$@(if wchar_t? '() (list "--disable-wchar_t"
+                                            "--enable-clocale=generic"
+                                            "--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no"))
                   #$building-on)))
         ((#:phases phases)
           #~(modify-phases #$phases
@@ -239,6 +244,10 @@ chain for " target " development."))
                  (("-rpath=") "-rpath-link="))
                #t))))))))
 
+(define-public linux-base-gcc (make-linux-base-gcc #:wchar_t? #f))
+;; GUI build
+(define-public linux-base-gcc-with-wchar_t (make-linux-base-gcc #:wchar_t? #t))
+
 (define glibc-2.31
   (let ((commit "28eb5caf895ced5d895cb02757e109004a2d33e5"))
   (package
diff --git a/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..f3fe8c1b3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+test: don't require std::wcrtomb for wchar_t log formatting
+
+libstdc++ built with --disable-wchar_t drops the std:: overloads
+from <cwchar>. Use the unqualified name so this keeps building against 
+such a toolchain (like in Guix).
+
+--- a/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
++++ b/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
+@@ -118,7 +118,7 @@ print_log_value<wchar_t>::operator()( std::ostream& ostr, wchar_t r )
+ {
+     std::mbstate_t state;
+     std::string mb(MB_CUR_MAX, '\0');
+-    std::size_t ret = std::wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
++    std::size_t ret = wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
+     if( ret > 0) {
+         ostr << mb;
+     }

</patch>

<previous_description>
{
 "summary": "Configures the GCC cross-compiler toolchain in Guix for non-GUI Linux targets with `--disable-wchar_t`, `--enable-clocale=generic`, and `--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no`, while also disabling experimental filesystem library builds. In addition, it patches Boost Test in the depends system to invoke `wcrtomb` instead of `std::wcrtomb` so unit tests compile against libstdc++ without wide-character support.",
 "problem": "Release Linux binaries include unused C++ runtime features like wide-character support, timezone info, and experimental filesystem routines from libstdc++, inflating binary sizes by roughly half a megabyte.",
 "card": "This PR disables wide-character support, zoneinfo, generic clocale, and experimental filesystem routines in Guix cross-compiled libstdc++ for non-GUI Linux binaries, keeping wchar_t enabled only for GUI targets. It also patches Boost Test to build without std::wcrtomb. The change reduces the size of release binaries like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli by roughly 0.5 MB.",

 }
